scenarios.expected: The Administrator reaches the app and the saved settings reflect the completed steps. Validation/retry and resumed onboarding work; no M33 checklist or Review step absent from this build is claimed.
scenarios.actual: Walked a genuinely fresh instance (needsSetup true) on http://127.0.0.1:43328. Set up OpenLaw refused a seven-character password at the field and refused mismatched entries with "The passwords do not match."; the corrected submission created the first Administrator and opened Welcome to OpenLaw. Contextual Help was observed on /auth/setup before any account existed and again on the unfinished wizard. The five steps Welcome, Authentication, Business-user portal, Outbound email and Invite your team behaved as documented: unregistered OIDC was refused, two bare domains saved, a reload returned to Welcome with saved settings intact but the step position lost, a middle-step Set up later advanced one step while onboarding stayed incomplete, and Set up later on Invite your team ended onboarding so /welcome then redirected Home. Email was exercised before completion across three immutable deployment phases: a stored app relay delivering a real test message, an environment override that made the pane read-only and sent a real invitation from the environment sender, an environment relay without SMTP_FROM that blocked delivery despite a complete stored relay, and recovery to the stored sender after removing the override and recreating app and worker.

limitations: Independent walkthroughs are agent walkthroughs, not human user studies or feature-owner approval.

Single sign-on was verified against a dedicated local OpenID Connect fixture. It is not certification of a real provider's client-secret handling or account policy, and it does not satisfy the real DocuSign and AI-provider verification required by DOC-022.

Onboarding completion is instance-wide and irreversible, so one instance permits one finishing action. Set up later on the final invitation step was exercised; Finish and the Welcome-step Set up later were not independently exercised here.
Evidence was taken on fixture app commit 6a8873dbda333fd9992eb77525d4bfa3f47af20d, not the final app candidate. DOC-025 reconciles the catalog against that candidate.
Operator and module configuration guides remain forward publication dependencies.
